name: S. V. J. Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, S. V. J. Enterprises does trading and manufacturing of FMCG goods, food grains, packaged food products, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SVJEL is in the business of selling, manufacturing, trading, processing agricultural products, honey products, food product, grains etc. It is also into manufacturing, trading and selling of silver paper plates

cons: Stock is trading at 16.9 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 5.03% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.36 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 292 days.
